## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and the reason for the change.

## Validation

- [ ] .NET build and tests pass.
- [ ] Web lint, type check, and build pass.
- [ ] New behavior has tests.
- [ ] Documentation and example configuration are updated.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and screenshots contain no secrets or local paths.
- [ ] New dependencies have license and provenance review.
- [ ] Hardware writes include rollback, audit, fault-injection, and qualification evidence.
